experiment_data.hypothesis: D023: Definitive re-eval of pruned_standard_20 and pruned_rasp_20 with current eval_gsm8k.py + load_pruned_model. N=100, max_new_tokens=4096, greedy. Validates whether original 1% vs 29% is reproducible with current code.
